sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: A simple, careful expression deeply connected to the territory and landscape is the core intention behind E.ME House. The design strategy focuses on achieving a compact dwelling with rich views and spatial variations resulting from the application of a common material: the 3-hole brick. This noble and everyday material takes on different configurations and applications to generate diverse expressions.
